nodes.label: mosquitto_main_loop()
nodes.desc: The broker is one single-threaded while(g_run) loop: each tick runs housekeeping timers ($SYS stats, keepalive, session expiry, will delay), then mux__handle() blocks until sockets are ready, then triggers the persistence autosave.

nodes.label: mux__handle()
nodes.desc: A tiny vtable that dispatches to epoll on Linux, kqueue on BSD/macOS or poll elsewhere. Every other part of the broker only ever sees mux__init/add_out/delete/handle, so OS-specific readiness lives in one file.

nodes.label: net__socket_accept()
nodes.desc: When a listener socket is readable, accepts the TCP connection and allocates a per-client struct mosquitto context, registering it with the mux.

nodes.label: handle__packet()
nodes.desc: Switch on the low nibble of the MQTT fixed header: CMD_CONNECT, CMD_PUBLISH, CMD_SUBSCRIBE, CMD_AUTH... each case bumps a metrics counter then calls the matching handler.

nodes.label: handle__connect()
nodes.desc: CONNECT handling: client id validation, MQTT 3.1.1/5 protocol version negotiation, will message registration, session takeover, then the auth chain before sending CONNACK.

nodes.label: handle__publish()
nodes.desc: PUBLISH handling: parses topic and payload, enforces QoS and retain rules, decodes MQTT 5 properties (topic alias, message expiry, subscription identifiers), then stores the message.

nodes.label: handle__subscribe()
nodes.desc: SUBSCRIBE handling: validates each topic filter, inserts a subleaf into the topic tree, replays retained messages, then sends SUBACK.

nodes.label: sub__messages_queue()
nodes.desc: Walks the hashed topic tree (mosquitto__subhier nodes, subleaf lists), matches + and # wildcards, and queues the stored message to every matching subscriber. Shared subscriptions get exactly one receiver.

nodes.label: retain__store()
nodes.desc: A second hashed tree (mosquitto__retainhier) that keeps the last retained message per topic. retain__queue() replays matching retained messages when a client subscribes.

nodes.label: db__message_store()
nodes.desc: The ref-counted mosquitto__base_msg store: one allocation per published message is shared by every subscriber, with per-client mosquitto__client_msg references tracking delivery state.

nodes.label: persist__backup()
nodes.desc: Serialises sessions, subscriptions, retained messages and in-flight QoS messages to the on-disk database; persist__restore() replays it at startup.

nodes.label: mosquitto_callback_register()
nodes.desc: The v4/v5 plugin event API: password_file, ACL file and the dynamic-security plugin all register MOSQ_EVT_BASIC_AUTH / MOSQ_EVT_ACL_CHECK / MOSQ_EVT_MESSAGE callbacks through this single choke point.
